quote: Under the agreement, CdA will source 72 Megawatts (MW) (550 GWh/year) from AES Gener’s growing renewable portfolio of wind, solar and hydroelectric energy… The Carmen de Andacollo renewable power arrangement is in effect as of September 1, 2020 and will run through to the end of 2031.
note: Opened AES Andes–Teck Carmen de Andacollo PPA primary (550 GWh/y; CapEx blank).
